record.edic_text:
4867 sunathroizo {soon-ath-royd'-zo}

from 4862 and athroizo (to hoard);; v

AV - gather together 2, call together 1; 3

1) to gather together with others
2) to assemble
3) to be gathered together i.e. to come together
